license.title: Offline license
license.description: Enter the signed EAI license key. Validation is performed locally and does not require an internet connection.

data_description.license_key: The license key starts with EAI1. and is issued by your EAI provider.

features.title: EAI Premium functions
features.description: One EAI Premium license enables every function. Select only the equipment and data sources available in this home.

data_description.heat_pump_enabled: Configure heat-pump, building and thermal analysis.
data_description.wallbox_enabled: Configure passive charging recommendations for a wallbox or vehicle.
data_description.weather_intelligence_enabled: Evaluate an installed Weather Fusion AI forecast, local observations and weather risks.

sensor_sources.title: Reuse existing sensor assignments
sensor_sources.description: EAI found compatible assignments published locally by installed Toorox integrations. Nothing is copied unless you enable reuse and confirm a source. Existing manual assignments always take precedence.

data_description.use_discovered_sensor_mappings: Review all proposed entities on the following pages before the configuration is saved.
data_description.heat_pump_sensor_source: Provides compatible compressor and, where available, backup-heater entities.
data_description.wallbox_sensor_source: Provides compatible wallbox power and energy entities.

heat_pump.title: Heat pump and building
heat_pump.description: Enter the technical details of the heat pump and its installation.

data.cop_rated: COP at the data-sheet test point

data_description.wp_type: Select the heat source and system type.
data_description.heating_capacity_kw: Rated heat output according to the data sheet, from 1 to 100 kW.
data_description.cop_rated: COP stated for a data-sheet test point such as A7/W35 or B0/W35. This is neither a live reading nor an annual performance factor. Keep the default 4.0 if unknown.
data_description.electrical_measurement_topology: Use legacy aggregate when heat-pump power and daily energy include every electrical component. Use separate when they represent the compressor only and backup-heater measurements are configured separately.
data_description.has_heating_element: Enable this if the system has an electric auxiliary heater.
data_description.has_dhw: Enable this if the heat pump also provides domestic hot water.
data_description.storage_volume_l: Expected: usable water or buffer volume from the data sheet. Unit: L. Optional; required to convert temperature loss into kWh.
data_description.building_ref: Optional name used to identify the building, for example Residential house.

required_sensors.title: Required sensors
required_sensors.description: Assign the three measurements required for the basic EAI functions.

data_description.wp_power_entity: Expected: sensor for the heat pump's current total electrical power input. Unit: W. Required.
data_description.wp_energy_today: Expected: electrical daily consumption meter for the heat pump, accumulated since 00:00 and reset at midnight. Unit: kWh. Required.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the current outdoor air temperature at the building. Unit: °C. Required.

standard_sensors.title: Standard sensors
standard_sensors.description: Assign available operating and temperature sensors. All fields on this page are optional.

data_description.indoor_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor in a representative indoor or reference room. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.target_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the currently configured room target temperature. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.operation_mode_entity: Expected: sensor with a stable text state for the operating mode, such as heating, domestic hot water, defrost, or off. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.compressor_entity: Expected: binary sensor, switch, or numeric compressor status. Unit: none. Optional; if absent, EAI uses the operating mode first and electrical power second.
data_description.heating_element_entity: Expected: binary sensor or switch for the electric backup heater. Unit: none. Optional; prevents ambiguous compressor inference.
data_description.heating_element_power_entity: Expected: current backup-heater electrical power. Unit: W. Optional.
data_description.heating_element_energy_today_entity: Expected: backup-heater energy accumulated since midnight. Unit: kWh. Optional.
data_description.dhw_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor in the domestic hot water tank; the probe position should be known. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.flow_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the current heating circuit flow temperature. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.return_temp_entity: Expected: sensor for the current return temperature of the same heating circuit. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.starts_entity: Expected: current compressor-start counter reading; counter resets must be detectable. Unit: count. Optional.
data_description.runtime_entity: Expected: operating-hours meter for total compressor runtime. Unit: h. Optional.
data_description.runtime_heating_entity: Expected: operating-hours meter for space heating only. Unit: h. Optional; combined with domestic hot water when no total meter exists.
data_description.runtime_dhw_entity: Expected: operating-hours meter for domestic hot water only. Unit: h. Optional; combined with space heating when no total meter exists.
data_description.runtime_counter_scope: Select the period covered by the operating-hours counter. The average runtime per start is calculated only when both counter periods match.
data_description.starts_counter_scope: Select the period covered by the start counter. Do not combine starts since midnight with lifetime operating hours.

advanced_sensors.title: Advanced sensors
advanced_sensors.description: Assign additional measurements for advanced analysis. All fields on this page are optional.

data_description.thermal_energy_entity: Expected: thermal consumption meter covering the same daily period and system boundary as the electrical daily consumption meter. Unit: thermal kWh. Optional; enables today's performance factor.
data_description.jaz_entity: Expected: an annual or measured performance factor already calculated by the system or a verified source. Unit: none. Optional; EAI does not invent one without matching heat and electricity meters.
data_description.volume_flow_entity: Expected: current heating-circuit volume flow with known fluid and measured circuit. Unit: l/min or m³/h. Optional; needed only for instantaneous COP calculation.
data_description.source_temp_entity: Expected: heat-source temperature sensor for outdoor air, brine, or groundwater. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.storage_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor in the buffer or domestic hot water tank; the probe position should be known. Unit: °C. Optional.
data_description.storage_ambient_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor directly at the storage tank or in the plant room, not in a living room. Unit: °C. Optional; with storage temperature and volume it enables loss analysis.
data_description.circulation_pump_entity: Expected: switch, binary sensor, or numeric state for the domestic-hot-water circulation pump. Unit: none. Optional; a smart plug is suitable and enables circulation-loss separation.
data_description.circulation_return_temp_entity: Expected: temperature sensor at the circulation return close to the storage tank. Unit: °C. Optional; used only as plausibility evidence.

wallbox_choice.title: E-mobility and wallbox
wallbox_choice.description: Enable optional wallbox analytics. EAI only creates recommendations and never sends control commands to the vehicle or wallbox.

data_description.wallbox_enabled: Enables joint planning of heat-pump demand and vehicle charging from residual PV energy.

wallbox.title: Wallbox and vehicle
wallbox.description: Assign measurements and charging targets for the primary wallbox. EAI only exposes passive advice and automation triggers.

data_description.wallbox_name: Free name for the vehicle or wallbox. Unit: none.
data_description.wallbox_power_entity: Expected: sensor for current wallbox charging power. Unit: W. Required.
data_description.wallbox_energy_today_entity: Expected: charging energy accumulated since midnight. Unit: kWh. Optional.
data_description.wallbox_connected_entity: Expected: binary sensor indicating that a vehicle is connected. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.wallbox_charging_entity: Expected: binary sensor indicating active charging. Unit: none. Optional.
data_description.ev_demand_mode: Expected: method used to determine charging demand. Unit: none. Select SoC, requested energy, or planned distance.
data_description.ev_soc_entity: Expected: current vehicle battery state of charge. Unit: %. Optional for SoC-based planning.
data_description.ev_required_energy_entity: Expected: requested additional battery energy from a Home Assistant helper or sensor. Unit: kWh. Optional alternative to SoC.
data_description.ev_planned_distance_entity: Expected: planned distance until the next departure from a Home Assistant helper or sensor. Unit: km. Optional alternative to SoC.
data_description.ev_battery_capacity_kwh: Usable vehicle battery capacity. Unit: kWh. Required for SoC-based planning.
data_description.ev_target_soc: Desired state of charge at departure. Unit: %. Required for SoC-based planning.
data_description.ev_consumption_kwh_per_100km: Expected average vehicle consumption. Unit: kWh/100 km. Required for distance-based planning.
data_description.ev_charging_efficiency_percent: Expected share of wallbox energy stored in the vehicle battery. Unit: %. Used for every planning mode.
data_description.ev_departure_time: Regular local time by which the charging target should be reached. Unit: local time. Required.
data_description.wallbox_max_power_kw: Maximum charging power available to the vehicle. Unit: kW. Required.

weather_intelligence.title: Weather intelligence
weather_intelligence.description: Uses bundled local weather-station data automatically for live values and Recorder history. Forecasts come from Weather Fusion AI.

data_description.weather_fusion_entry_id: Select the Weather Fusion AI configuration for this EAI installation.
data_description.weather_history_days: Keep EAI forecast-evaluation records for 7 to 365 days. This does not copy the complete WFAI raw history.

validation.title: Sensor validation
validation.description: The sensor assignment must be corrected before setup can continue. Missing entities: {missing}. Duplicate assignments: {duplicates}.

automation_inputs.title: Prices for automation signals
automation_inputs.description: Optional: Assign electricity price and feed-in tariff data. EAI never controls equipment and only exposes passive signals.

data_description.electricity_price_entity: Expected: sensor or input_number helper for the current import price. Unit: EUR/kWh or ct/kWh. Optional.
data_description.electricity_price_unit: Use automatic detection from the sensor or select a fixed unit for helpers without one.
data_description.feed_in_tariff_entity: Expected: sensor or input_number helper for the current feed-in tariff. Unit: EUR/kWh or ct/kWh. Optional.
data_description.feed_in_tariff_unit: Use automatic detection from the sensor or select a fixed unit for helpers without one.
data_description.low_price_threshold_ct: Price below which EAI signals a low-price window. Unit: ct/kWh.

summary.description: License: {license_id}. Available capability level: {capability}. Forecasting is not active yet.
